name_en: PM-KUSUM / Solar Powered Pumpsets Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE); in Tamil Nadu run by the Agricultural Engineering Department
benefit: You get a standalone solar pump (3 HP to 15 HP) for irrigation with a big subsidy. Small and marginal SC/ST farmers get 80%. Other SC/ST farmers and small and marginal general farmers get 70%. Other general farmers get 60%. For pumps above 7.5 HP, the subsidy is only for 7.5 HP.

other: You must have a reliable water source but no electricity connection for it.
New wells must be in 'safe' firkas for ground water. In other areas, only diesel pumps can be replaced with solar.
Farmers who pay their share first get the pump first.

how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkusum.tn.gov.in. Do not pay money on fake PM-KUSUM websites.
where_to_apply: Agricultural Engineering Department: Assistant Engineer or Junior Engineer at the block, Assistant Executive Engineer at the revenue division, Executive Engineer at the district.

evidence.quote: Provision of Off-grid Standalone Solar powered pumpsets (AC and DC type) with capacities ranging from 3 HP to 15 HP for irrigation purposes to farmers.

Individual farmers, Water User Associations and community/cluster based irrigation system will be covered under this component.
All farmers who have a reliable water source for irrigation but without an electrical power connection.
New irrigation wells should be located in safe firkas of ground water extraction
diesel engine pumpsets used in reliable water sources shall be replaced with solar powered pumpsets.
Solar powered pumpsets will be installed on a priority basis for farmers who remit their beneficiary contribution amount first.

gaps: The sources do not list documents needed.

The helpline is the national MNRE number, shown on the portal in Hindi.
